description: Additive deterministic repository guards and lease-scoped whitespace quality hooks; review and trust using /hooks.

hooks.command: node -e "const s=require('node:child_process').spawnSync;const e=process.argv[1];const r=s('git',['rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:3000,windowsHide:true});if(r.status!==0){console.error('훅 시작 실패: git 작업 공간을 확인한다.');process.exit(e==='PreToolUse'?2:1)}const p=s(process.execPath,[require('node:path').join(r.stdout.trim(),'scripts/agent-guard.js'),e],{stdio:'inherit',timeout:25000,windowsHide:true});if(p.status!==0){console.error('훅 핸들러 실패: Node/파일/입력을 확인하고 최소 검사를 재실행한다.');process.exit(e==='PreToolUse'?2:1)}" SessionStart
